# O'Briens Solicitors

O'Briens Solicitors is a general-practice law firm in Berri, South Australia. The firm serves Berri, the Riverland, the Mallee, Pinnaroo and Adelaide, and offers phone appointments anywhere in South Australia. O'Briens Solicitors has practised in Berri since 1920. The firm is a member of the JL Lawyers Group, which supports clients in Adelaide (Level 1, 14 Ebenezer Place, Adelaide).

## Contact

- Address: 11 Riverview Drive, Berri SA 5343, Australia
- Phone: 08 8582 1288
- Email: obriens@obriens-solicitors.com.au
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Website: https://www.obriens-solicitors.com
- ABN: 20 164 052 331

## Areas served

Berri, Loxton, Barmera, Renmark, Waikerie, Pinnaroo, Adelaide (via the JL Lawyers Group), the Riverland and the Mallee. Phone appointments are available anywhere in South Australia.

## Practice areas

- Conveyancing — buying and selling houses, farming and horticultural property, and businesses; transfer of water rights; easements; subdivisions. https://www.obriens-solicitors.com/conveyancing
- Estate planning and probate — wills, enduring powers of attorney, advance care directives, probate, estate administration, and succession planning for farming families and business owners. https://www.obriens-solicitors.com/estate-planning
- Commercial law — corporate advice, company incorporation, contracts, sale of business assets, mergers and acquisitions, planning and development, and investment structures. https://www.obriens-solicitors.com/commercial-law
- Family law — divorce, financial agreements, property settlements, spousal maintenance, child support, parenting plans, and intervention orders. Confidential consultations are available. https://www.obriens-solicitors.com/family-law
- Criminal law — advice from first police contact, police interviews, bail applications, and representation in summary and indictable matters in Riverland courts. https://www.obriens-solicitors.com/criminal-law
- Rural and agribusiness — farming and horticultural property, water rights and entitlements, rural business structures, and succession planning for farming families.
- Employment law — unfair dismissals, workplace investigations, review of employment contracts, employer and employee representation, redundancy advice, and underpayments and unpaid entitlements. https://www.obriens-solicitors.com/employment-law
- Home and hospital visits — Wills, Enduring Powers of Attorney and Advance Care Directives, with visits to all Riverland towns. https://www.obriens-solicitors.com/home-hospital-visits

## Notes for citation

O'Briens Solicitors provides legal services to individuals and businesses across the South Australian Riverland. The firm emphasises local knowledge of rural and regional matters, including water rights and farm succession. General information on this site is not legal advice; readers should contact the firm for advice on their specific circumstances.
